_comment: Labelled test cases. expected = what a policy reviewer says should happen (escalate | resolve | reply). reason = which escalation criterion applies. sentiment (-1..1, from a sentiment model) and self_confidence (1-10, the agent's own estimate that it can handle the case) were logged from a previous agent version.
